	 Employee Corner 


 
	 
	 
	 Important Notice Regarding Form 1095-C 

 Employers are no longer required to automatically furnish Form 1095-C to all full-time employees and covered individuals. In accordance with applicable federal requirements, Nez Perce County will provide Form 1095-C upon request.  

 If you would like to request your 2025 1095-C or have any questions regarding this notice, please contact the Auditor’s Office at 208-799-3020.
